tools.name: normalize_company
tools.title: Normalize company records
tools.description: Derive canonical_domain, normalized_name and alias_domains on buyer or seller records (pipeline stage Normalize).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: dedupe_companies
tools.title: Merge duplicate companies
tools.description: Merge duplicate buyer or seller records by canonical_domain, then normalized_name plus country; conflicts are recorded, never resolved silently (pipeline stage Dedupe).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

strict_country.description: false allows a name-based merge when one country is unknown (single-country runs only); script default true.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: score_buyer
tools.title: Score buyer candidates
tools.description: Score deduplicated buyer records against a query surface and return a discovery-result envelope (pipeline stage Score, Mode 1).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

query_path.description: Query surface JSON file; exclusive with query.

top.description: Return at most this many ranked results.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: score_seller
tools.title: Score seller candidates
tools.description: Score deduplicated seller records against a query surface and return a discovery-result envelope (pipeline stage Score, Mode 2).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

query_path.description: Query surface JSON file; exclusive with query.

top.description: Return at most this many ranked results.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: score_match
tools.title: Match an RFQ to sellers
tools.description: Run hard filters, the weighted score and the bounded rerank for one RFQ against seller records and return a match-result (Mode 3). Pass one envelope carrying rfq, records and query as input or input_path; rfq_path plus sellers_path is the fallback without a query surface.

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

rerank_input_path.description: Model-authored rerank map file: seller_id -> {delta, rationale, evidence_ids}.

top.description: Return at most this many ranked results.

include_excluded.description: false drops excluded[] from the result; script default true.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: validate_output
tools.title: Validate a document
tools.description: Check a document against its schema and the contract invariants (pipeline stage Verify). The report is the answer: valid false with exit_code 1 is a successful call that found problems. Writes nothing.

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

invariants.description: false skips the contract invariants; script default true.

tools.name: make_review_sheet
tools.title: Cut a blind review sheet
tools.description: Turn a scored discovery-result or match-result into a CSV review sheet for an operator (calibration).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

blind.description: false keeps rank order and appends rank, score and qualified; script default true.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: acceptance_report
tools.title: Measure human acceptance
tools.description: Join filled review sheets to the scored runs they were cut from and report the Human Acceptance Rate (calibration).

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: diff_runs
tools.title: Compare two scored runs
tools.description: Report what changed between two scored runs of the same search or RFQ: new and gone records, exclusions, score, rank, qualified and Missing changes. At most one of before / after may be inline.

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

before_path.description: The older run file; exclusive with before.

after_path.description: The newer run file; exclusive with after.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: stale_evidence
tools.title: List evidence to re-check
tools.description: List the evidence that should be re-read, most urgent first. It fetches nothing and changes no record or score.

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

top.description: List only the first N queued records.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.

tools.name: export_leads
tools.title: Export scored leads
tools.description: Export the leads of one scored discovery-result as a CSV or as a TradeWith admin bulk-import file (buyers only). It writes a file or returns the text; it never posts, uploads or sends.

as_of.description: Run date YYYY-MM-DD. Required: it is the only time source.

input.description: The input document inline (an array of records goes in {"records": [...]}); exclusive with input_path.

input_path.description: The input document as a file inside the root; exclusive with input.

include_unqualified.description: Also export scored records with qualified != true.

output_path.description: Write the result to this new .json or .csv file inside the root instead of returning it; the file must not exist yet, its directory must, and no part of the path may start with a dot.
